text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (I can see it...! That's it...! This green turf stretching before my eyes is just like...)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(—A wave! Carrying me,
pushing me forward, onward!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Go!
Feel the wind. Feel the waves.
Catch all that power with these sails...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Tap Dance City with an astonishing run!
A victory that sends shockwaves through the entire crowd!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
There is no comparison. There is no comparison, but
this running is almost as if—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
F-F-F-Friendship power...
Trainer...
I give a quiet nod to myself. How it should be evaluated varies from person to person, but...
Today, Tap Dance City undeniably closed in on the legend of Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, the Kinko Sho, huh?
Sounds great, I like the sound of this race!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"The perfect race for me!
It fits weirdly well!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, maybe I'll run. Next year, the year after.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Three-peat!
A three-peat, I'm definitely taking the three-peat!"

Tap Dance City makes her speech in high spirits.
Her tone, too, is clearly riding high on the momentum.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, this is my running.
Were you watching, Hishi Miracle? And—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (Did you see that, Silence Suzuka? ...Wait, there's no way you'd actually come to watch, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: There's no way they came to watch, though...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Heh, to think *you* would be here.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Symboli Kris S...! 
An Umamusume from America, just like me.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (Lately, some folks have been whispering that I'm the 'strongest active runner'—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Watching my run today,
what are your thoughts, Kris S?)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Heh, those aren't the eyes of someone giving up.
Those eyes are—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: (Those are the eyes of a hawk locking onto its prey.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OKay. If you're still not intimidated
after seeing my run today—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The time has come...
Right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we need to talk.
choice_data_list: Tap, I need to talk to you.
Tap, I need to talk to you about something.

text_block_list.text: We both brought it up at almost the exact same time.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Me first. I go first.
There's a race I want to run
before the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen, the Grand Prix that concludes the spring season.
And there—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I just really wanted to beat her.
That Symboli Kris S!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
She's widely called the strongest active racer.
Naturally, she'll be running in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can't set off with a clear mind
unless I run against her at least once.

It's true that I've never raced against
Symboli Kris S even once.

If I was going overseas as a national representative,
she was an opponent I needed to beat.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, how'd your errand go?
choice_data_list: Same here. I was thinking of heading to the Takarazuka Kinen next.
Same here. I was thinking of heading to the Takarazuka Kinen next.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see! Hahaha,
you and I see eye-to-eye as always.

Though our intentions aligned, my reason for fitting
the Takarazuka Kinen in differed from Tap Dance City's.

Yes, "buying time."
Before starting full-scale travel preparations,
I need a little more time to calculate the costs.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Then it's settled. The next race is the Takarazuka Kinen.
And on that stage—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone once more that nothing is impossible!
Even against Kris S, the one they call the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Whew, Tap-chan. Great job out there~
You were seriously amazing today."
—And Hishi Miracle walked over to them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Turns out you can do it if you put your mind to it.
Guess that gave me a little courage too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I'm glad it's to your liking.
However, in the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you something even more amazing.
Well? You wanna see it, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder. I feel like it's plenty good enough,
but if you're willing to show me, sure.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you.
And right in front of your eyes, no less.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, right in front of you, huh...
I had a pretty good view this time around too, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There's more. Now that this courage
has finally sprouted, next—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You wanna test yourself, right?
Against me and Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Going up against Tap-chan
and Kris S-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're running too!
In the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now let's party!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhhh, me too~?
Tap-chan, are you really, really serious~?

"Hishi Miracle gets dragged into it.
And so, before the overseas expedition—
with the title of the nation's strongest on the line—"

"It was decided that I would clash
with Symboli Kris S at the Takarazuka Kinen."
